summary: Companies in Bulgaria's textile, sewing and leather industries are in an extremely difficult position. A growing number are limiting operations and cutting staff.
why: Textile and leather manufacturing is a labor-intensive export sector, and its contraction signals pressure on manufacturing employment and exports in Eastern Europe.
